authority.financialMutation: Backend transaction and verified provider/accounting rules

observedBackend.observedNumericStorage: Prisma Decimal(12,2) for Booking.estimatedFare, Booking.finalFare, and PricingRule monetary rule fields; multiplier Decimal(8,4).

requestAndQuotePrinciples: Customer-supplied customerId does not establish identity; authenticated session resolves the customer.
Road distance/duration is sourced by Backend routing, not trusted from client-supplied fare fields.
Quote/estimated fare is calculated by Backend pricing rules; client displays Backend result only.
Coupon/promo validity and pricing must be rechecked by Backend during booking confirmation.
Payment/provider success and final fare are separate authoritative states; a client success label is not payment proof.
financialRulesNotInvented: No new base fare, per-kilometre, per-minute, waiting, weight, minimum/maximum, commission, discount, tax or surge amounts are selected here.
Existing pricing.ts values/formulas are implementation evidence only until reconciled with the approved financial source-of-truth and test vectors.
Exact rounding points/order of operations and all monetary boundary vectors require finance/product sign-off.
Quote identifier/version/expiry, price-lock duration, fare-change consent and currency representation require explicit contract review; no quote TTL or currency column is assumed.
Repricing/cancellation/waiting charges/partial route changes/refund interactions need approved acceptance rules.
finalTestVectorsRequired: minimum distance and distance rounding boundary
zero/missing/negative/huge inputs rejected or normalized per approved policy
each passenger ride type and Full Ride no passenger-count collection
Event per-passenger/session fare and capacity boundaries
each parcel subtype and goods size/type/weight boundary
route provider timeout/invalid route/alternate route behavior
decimal precision, rounding and ledger/payment amount equality
